title: Died In Days
text:
Died In Days. When I got this the UV lights weren't that bright though they seemed to get brighter after a few moments. Even then it wasn't all that bright and I can't see that it would do much good at all as you have to hold it above whatever you want to disinfect. It lights an area about three or four inches by a half inch. That means three or four sessions to do a phone, ages to do a laptop's keyboard, etc.
But that's besides the point. I tried this a couple times. Put it aside, safely I might add, it wasn't dropped, bumped or damaged in any way. Last night I went to use it again. . . and it's dead. The power light comes on when you press the button but the UV bulbs do nothing. I pulled the batteries it came with and installed four brand new ones of my own and. . . nothing. I tried powering it from a USB cable with and without the batteries installed, nothing. Unit is dead. Used two, maybe three times, a grand total of five minutes and now it's a paperweight. Actually, it's in the trash where it belongs.
I do NOT recommend this device. Even when it briefly worked it was unimpressive.
